title: Book Two · Chapter 171: Not Jun's Answer
story:
Jun drops a drawing sheet near the steps on Friday. Ronan catches it before a shoe lands on the corner. He holds it by the clean edge and gives it back.

“Thank you,” Jun says.

The drawing shows a street with tall windows. There are no animals. Ronan looks for the difficult wall from their game, but he cannot find it.

“Your wall stayed out?” he asks.

“It could not sit still.”

They smile. Jun puts the sheet inside a stiff cover. Ronan stands beside him longer than he needs to.

“Can I ask you something?”

Jun keeps one hand on the cover. “About the drawing?”

“About the practice record.”

“I do not keep that.”

“I know. One of my marks is wrong.”

Jun looks at him. He waits. He lets Ronan explain the wrong mark.

“The fourth task,” Ronan says. “Leo helped me find the important line. The record says independent.”

“Does the original page say that?”

“The page says HELP. It is inside the fold.”

Jun shuts the cover. “Then show Miss Wu.”

Ronan looks at the ground. “Then I cannot take the final tasks.”

“I heard the rules.”

“I can do that kind of page alone now.”

“This is the record for that day.”

Ronan feels angry. Jun says it so simply. But Ronan wants the place. He has thought about it all week.

“You do not want the place,” he says.

Jun's face changes. “That does not make it my wrong mark.”

The words stop Ronan. He looks at Jun's cover, then at the paper inside it.

“No,” he says. “It does not.”

For a moment, neither boy moves. Other students pass them on the steps.

“Please do not speak for me,” Ronan says.

“I was not going to. You asked me.”

“Yes.”

Jun picks up his bag. He has drawing work to finish with Mei. He tells Ronan the time, then goes inside.

Ronan stays near the steps. He wants Jun to come back and say something easier. Jun does not come back.

After lunch, Ronan asks Leo the sample questions as they agreed. Leo misses one room name and corrects it. Ronan points to the line, then lets him try again. The work takes fifteen minutes.

When they finish, Ronan gives the page back. He keeps that promise. The fourth practice page is still in his folder. He carries it home with the unfinished note and puts both on his table before he takes off his shoes.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

stiff＝硬挺的；original＝原始的；record＝记录；promise＝承诺。

## 理解问题

1. Jun为什么说这不是由他来承担的错误记号？
2. Ronan怎样回应了Jun明确而不舒服的答案？

## 读句子

**He keeps that promise.**

拆开看：He / keeps / that promise.

他／履行／那个承诺。
